Rank chapter quality audit

The audit checks exact matrix bases, arithmetic, composition dimensions, parameter branches, rank inequalities, exceptional scalar fields, authentic source hashes and formula rendering. The English lesson includes full central proofs and advanced consequences with explicit hypotheses; the review rules are complete sentences rather than formula fragments.

The worked bank distinguishes course-derived tasks, original tasks and authentic revisits. Computer algebra independently checks rational reductions, all four spaces and stated parameter families. Finite enumeration checks small-field counts and sharp rank inequalities. Neither these finite checks nor a page count replaces the theorem proofs.

Original SVG figures and chapter-specific animations explain domain/output distinction, original pivot columns, fibers, four spaces, inverse direction, factorization, compositions, exceptional rank, cancellation and projection geometry. Exact checkpoint data and real movement are checked independently. Animations that collapse a direction state the exact rank at the singular checkpoint rather than claiming rank is continuously interpolated.

Browser checks cover dedicated STIX Two Math for formula matrices and indices, diagram labels, code font, mobile containment, print solutions, laboratory arithmetic and animation controls. Source PDFs are kept private; study progress and earlier approved chapter banks are preserved.

The chapter remains a review draft until explicit user approval. Actual check counts and rendered results are saved in its evidence files after verification. Finite access and test limitations remain visible; a literal guarantee for all unseen questions is not inferred.
